reviews.text: We had an incredible experience with First Class Pools & Spas from start to finish. The entire team was professional, communicative, and truly committed to bringing our vision to life. They took the time to understand exactly what we wanted, offered great design suggestions, and delivered a finished pool and outdoor space that exceeded our expectations. Every step of the process was handled with care and attention to detail, and it was clear they genuinely take pride in their work. We absolutely love our new pool and outdoor area, and we’ve already received so many compliments from friends and neighbors. Highly recommend First Class Pools & Spas to anyone looking for quality, craftsmanship, and outstanding customer service!
reviews.author: Whitney Cameron

reviews.text: Highly recommend working with First Class Pools & Spas!  We had no idea what to do with our small backyard, didn’t even know if a pool was an option, until we met Mike Light and his team.  They came out, looked at the space, asked about our ideas, wants and needs, and within a matter of days had a 3D rendering ready for us to review.  We knew the instant we saw the design we picked the right pool company to work with.  Communication, customer service and attention to detail were on point through the whole process.   Mike & Ruby gave us realistic expectations and were on schedule through the entire process.  Special shout out to Ryan Navarro who was on-site countless times to make sure everything was going according to plan.  We are so happy with the incredible quality of the entire project! Thank you so much for making our backyard dreams come true!
reviews.author: Christa Fulton

reviews.text: First Class certainly lives up to its name.  All aspects of our pool were first class.  From the design, working through difficult permitting issues to the construction process and final product.  Mike’s designs were state of the art and really captured the what we wanted in a pool while creating a design that accentuates our house. Ryan was amazing.  Her was always there to answer questions and give guidance and recommendations.  Even after finishing the pool, he immediately answered a question on a Saturday night.  If you want a company that still believes in customer service, you will pick First Class for your pool.
reviews.author: Mark B.

reviews.text: First Class Pools and Spas worked diligently with us each step of the way to complete our pool project. We were impressed with how they translated our initial ideas into a beautiful pool design that worked for our space. Their attention to detail was top-notch, and they were very responsive when we had questions or concerns. They communicated well, keeping us informed with each step in the build process, and took the time to explain anything we didn’t understand. The result? A backyard that is beautiful in form and function, one that we will enjoy for years to come. We are thrilled! Thank you, FCPS!
reviews.author: Lori

reviews.text:
The quality, service, design, and communication are truly first class. They stand behind the quality of their builds and promptly handle and remedy any issues or warranties after the project is complete. Even after the big ice storm last year and before, they communicated what owners needed to do to protect their equipment and pretty much had their team staged to assist and repair customers pool equipment if they had been impacted by the hard freeze.

To those considering what pool company to use, just keep in mind you get what you pay for. We had to terminate the first company we went with due to slow progress and poor communication. That “Premiere” company was anything but. Mike and his team at First Class Pool & Spas came in, gave us a thoughtful design based on our wants and space, and delivered a phenomenal product my family utilizes anytime the weather permits.
reviews.author: Paul J

reviews.text: Dishonest, lack integrity, horrible communication. There are lots of pool builders out there, don't take your chances with this one.
reviews.author: Proshad Efune

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic. The positive reviews contain specific, credible details about employees, processes, and post-sale support. The single negative review raises a common contractor complaint (communication) but is an isolated data point. The cluster of three 5-star Google reviews from 5 months ago is a minor anomaly but not definitive proof of fakery given the otherwise authentic signals and consistent high ratings.
fake_signals: Three 5-star reviews posted within the same month (5 months ago) with similar positive but generic themes
